_doc: Expected occurrences of the four-letter name in learner-facing audio targets, vocabulary items, Latin spellings and respellings. A finding not covered here, or more than max, fails tests/sensitivity.test.js. status known-issue = should be fixed by the owner lane, then the entry lowered or removed; accepted = judged consistent with docs/sensitivity/CONVENTIONS.md by this audit (not clergy-reviewed).

entries.reason: Audio target for a prefixed form (lamed, bet, vav + the name): spokenText()/spoken() in the manifest builder only rewrite the bare word. Owner: audio lane. The pointing of the spoken form needs clergy approval; do not invent it.
